items.title: Yat Tung Heen — Michelin-Star Dim Sum Brunch #2
items.hours: Sat, Sun & PH: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM (last order 3:30 PM); 6:00–10:30 PM (last order 9:30 PM). Takeaway 12–9 PM daily.
items.getThere: Level B2, Eaton HK, 380 Nathan Road, Jordan, Kowloon.
highlights: One Michelin star every year 2017–2026; Cantonese kitchen led by Chef Tam Tung, in a moody 1920s-Shanghai-tavern dining room.
Signatures on the restaurant's menu page: Signature Honey-glazed Barbecued Pork (char siu), Golden Fried Crispy Chicken Skin and Meat with steamed pancakes, Roasted Suckling Pig.
Menus listed: Dim Sum Set Lunch, Chef's Winter Recommendations, Michelin Degustation 2026.
tips: Book via SevenRooms (linked from the restaurant site) or call +852 2710 1093 / 2710 1094; LINE ID yattungheen.
The 'dine-in dim sum lunch deal' is weekday-only — not available on Saturday.
Protein: char siu, roast suckling pig and crispy chicken are the meat-forward anchors.
items.watch: Per-dish prices were not readable on the published menus; budget is unverified.

items.title: 60th Hong Kong Brands & Products Expo — Opening Day
items.hours: 12 Dec 2026 – 4 Jan 2027 (24 days). 11:00 AM – 9:00 PM daily to 3 Jan; last day 11 AM – 8 PM. No admission in the final 30 min (final hour on the last day).
highlights: 11 themed zones and 900+ outdoor booths (organiser CMA).
Zones include Hong Kong Brands Square, Food & Beverages, Grocery & Noodles, Ginseng/Dried Seafood & Soup Packs, Beauty & Healthcare, Living & Household, Chillax Zone, Food Plaza, Hometown Flavors.
Stage performances, shopping offers and lucky draws.
tips: Head for the Food Plaza and Hometown Flavors zones for snacks; Food & Beverages for samples.
Opening day is Saturday Dec 12; the gates open at 11 AM, so an 11:30 arrival is inside hours.
items.watch: Admission fee was not shown on the organiser pages checked.

sources.label: HKBPE: The 60th Hong Kong Brands and Products Expo

items.title: Ding Ding Tram West → Wan Chai (20–30 min)
items.getThere: Board any westbound tram in Causeway Bay (routes to Kennedy Town, Shek Tong Tsui or Western Market) and ride through Wan Chai to Central.
tips: Pay when you leave by the front exit: Octopus, Visa/Mastercard/UnionPay/JCB/Amex, Apple/Google/Samsung Pay, or QR codes.
Cash goes straight into the coin box — no change on board.

items.title: Star Ferry: Wan Chai → TST
items.hours: Central ↔ TST Saturday sailings every 6–8 min from ~7:25 AM to ~10:30–10:40 PM.
items.cost: Sat, Sun & PH adult: upper deck HK$6.5, lower deck HK$5.6.
items.getThere: Walk the Central Harbourfront (AIA Vitality Park, Observation Wheel) to the Central Star Ferry Pier → Tsim Sha Tsui Star Ferry Pier.
tips: Octopus at the gate, HKD cash (HK$10/HK$20 notes and coins; change given), or QR/credit card at the ticket machines.
Upper deck costs ~HK$1 more and has the better view.
items.watch: No eating or drinking on board.

sources.label: Discover Hong Kong: Observation Wheel & AIA Vitality Park

items.title: Aqua Luna Evening Harbour Cruise — Tsim Sha Tsui Pier 1
items.hours: Evening Harbour Cruise sailings at 4:30, 5:30, 6:30 and 8:30 PM; 45 minutes. Sailings on the half-hour return to your boarding pier.
items.cost: Adult HK$280, child (4–11) HK$180; one complimentary drink per ticket.
items.getThere: Pick-up points: Tsim Sha Tsui Public Pier 1 and Central Pier 9 (two pick-ups per cruise; check the timetable for the order).
highlights: Lounge beds on deck; the 5:30 PM sailing catches sunset turning into city lights.
The sunset sailing pairs with an aqualuna Sundowner mocktail.
tips: Pick TST Pier 1 as your boarding pier when booking so the 5:30 PM loop returns you to TST.
One free reschedule if requested 12+ hours before departure; within 12 hours HK$50 per person.
items.watch: Tickets are non-refundable. Sailing cancelled if Typhoon Signal No. 3 or Red Rainstorm (or higher) is hoisted; the route may change for weather.

items.title: Winter Wonderland in Tsim Sha Tsui
items.getThere: Hong Kong Cultural Centre precinct; MTR Tsim Sha Tsui or East Tsim Sha Tsui.
highlights: Projection mapping on the Hong Kong Cultural Centre, Museum of Art and Space Museum — a Christmas concert inspired by the northern lights.
tips: Vantage points: the Cultural Centre Viewing Deck, or outside the Museum of Art and Space Museum.
items.watch: Show schedule is subject to change without prior notice.

sources.label: Discover Hong Kong: Winter Wonderland in Tsim Sha Tsui
